title: PH v0.5 AR-THF Qualification Gates P0-r2

Q0.name: freeze_integrity
Q0.criterion: all required P0-r2 files parse; static cross-file contract audit PASS; no simulator/run_qual/run_pilot/run_confirmatory/execution_authorization under P0-r2

Q1.name: endpoint_dynamic_range
Q1.criterion: G0 Qualification: H_V occupies >=4 distinct D_grid bins across 50 master seeds; median |Omega_low-Omega_high| >=0.05; median H_I >=0.05

Q2.name: access_purity
Q2.criterion: A1 changes only sample interval, delay, observation surface and R; paired PLANT path is identical across A1 levels; generator coefficient hash unchanged

Q3.name: model_independent_A2
Q3.criterion: A2 implementation accepts physical center/pulse/node-position table only; model identity and latent node labels are not arguments; all three centers executed

Q4.name: A0_oracle_equivalence
Q4.criterion: G0 vs G6 paired noiseless A0 max absolute trajectory difference <=1e-10 for all 50 Qualification seeds and all 5 fully deterministic A0 profiles

Q5.name: A2_positive_reach
Q5.criterion: G0 A2: median normalized RMS intervention response versus zero >=0.10 and median target response SNR >=5.0 over all three centers

Q6.name: A3_environment_reach
Q6.criterion: median G0 H_I >=0.05 and 99% bootstrap lower bound of median(G0 H_I)-median(null H_I) >0.02

Q7.name: history_match_quality
Q7.criterion: post-reset canonical max mismatch <=1e-10 for every pair and G4 median d_G4 <=0.01

Q8.name: null_canary_suite
Q8.criterion: All five frozen null canaries must fail to support their corresponding hypothesis: H1 sham-identical access; H2 zero-parameter-change controls; H3 lambda_I-fixed lattice; H4 G4 historyless; H5 G0-vs-G0 duplicate. Any false support => FAIL.

Q9.name: numerical_estimability
Q9.criterion: all arrays finite; EKF convergence >=95%; no covariance determinant <=1e-12; H_V floor occupancy <0.80 and ceiling occupancy <0.80; no metric run exceeds 10000 integration steps after its metric-specific reset
